tips: Use console.log() to understand what your code is doing at each step.
Keep your CSS small and organized. Group related styles together.
Name variables based on their purpose, not just x or data.
Break large functions into smaller helpers that do one thing well.
Use the browser dev tools to inspect HTML, CSS, and network requests.
Commit small changes often so you can undo if something breaks.
Comment your code, but focus on explaining why, not what.
